title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

  


### **Discover more about working at Agoda**


* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
* LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
* YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.


**Disclaimer**



We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third\-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

title: Executive Manager
description:
Overview:

A backend\-leaning full\-stack developer who can build and maintain server\-side architecture, databases, and APIs while managing essential front\-end integrations to deliver complete web applications

  


Responsibilities:
* Design \& Build Services\- Create scalable microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud.
* Implement Distributed Patterns \- Manage service discovery, API gateways, and circuit breakers.
* Event\-Driven Integration \- Connect services using message brokers like Kafka or messaging queues.
* Containerization \& Deployment \- Deploy and orchestrate services using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
* Develop Autonomous Agents \- Build intelligent agents capable of task automation, reasoning loops (like ReAct), and decision\-making.
* Orchestrate Workflows \- Set up multi\-agent collaboration patterns, routing, and prompt chaining.
* Vector \& RAG Integration \- Integrate Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search) with Java backends.
* API Connectivity \- Link LLM providers (OpenAI, Hugging Face) securely via REST APIs  

Track agent behaviours, system latency, and failure rates in production environments.
* Partner with DevOps teams to automate testing and streamline deployments

  


Qualifications:
* **Backend Languages:** Node.js, Python, Java.
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis.
* **Frontend Basics:** JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* **DevOps \& Tools:** Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
* **Experience:** 9\+ years

title: Java, K8, AI, Kafka, MongoDB/Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist


In this role, you will:

* API \& Backend Development: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance, secure, and scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and modern Java. AI\-Assisted Engineering: Utilize AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate feature development, code generation, refactoring, and unit test creation.
* DevOps \& Containerization: Build, maintain, and automate CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins. Package, deploy, and manage containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Messaging \& Event\-Driven Architecture: Design and integrate messaging workflows using platforms like Apache Kafka or GCP Pub/Sub.
* Database Management: Work with NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and relational databases, optimizing queries, schemas, and data persistence models.
* Code Quality \& Security: Enforce coding standards through static code analysis (SonarQube) and proactively resolve security vulnerabilities and compliance issues.
* Security \& Authentication: Implement robust authentication/authorization patterns, including JWT.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Write and execute comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito to ensure system reliability and code coverage.
* Performance Tuning \& Debugging: Conduct load/performance testing, troubleshoot production issues, resolve bottlenecks, and perform root\-cause analysis.


To be successful in this role, candidate should meet the following requirements:

* Java \& Spring Framework: 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with Java (11/21\+) and Spring Boot.
* REST APIs \& Security: Deep understanding of RESTful architectural principles, API design best practices, and JWT authentication.
* AI Coding Tools: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to optimize productivity while maintaining code quality and security standards.
* DevOps Tools: Hands\-on experience with Jenkins, Docker, and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Messaging Systems: Proven experience implementing messaging architectures with Kafka, Pub/Sub.
* Databases: Working knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB) and database design principles.
* Languages \& Formats: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, and configuration/markup languages (JSON, YAML).
* Security \& Quality Tools: Experience with quality scan tools like SonarQube and fix security vulnerabilities. Testing: Proficiency in unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito).


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. title: Senior Software Engineer (Java,Spring boot)
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a...

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead moderately complex initiatives and deliverables within technical domain environments
* Contribute to large scale planning of strategies
* Design, code, test, debug, and document for projects and programs associated with technology domain, including upgrades and deployments
* Review moderately complex technical challenges that require an in\-depth evaluation of technologies and procedures
* Resolve moderately complex issues and lead a team to meet existing client needs or potential new clients needs while leveraging solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, or compliance requirements
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid\-level managers to resolve technical challenges and achieve goals
* Lead projects and act as an escalation point, provide guidance and direction to less experienced staff

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience in designing, developing, and supporting enterprise\-scale applications.


	+ Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture.
	+ Hands\-on experience with React.js and modern front\-end development frameworks, including state management and responsive UI development.
	+ Experience designing and implementing Event\-Driven Architectures using messaging and streaming platforms.
	+ Working knowledge of Apache Kafka concepts, producers, consumers, topics, partitions, and event\-driven integration patterns.
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, Harness, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.
	+ Strong source control and branching strategy experience using Git.
	+ Experience developing and maintaining automated unit tests, integration tests, and test automation frameworks.
	+ Hands\-on experience with at least one cloud platform, preferably GCP or AWS. Azure experience is also acceptable.
	+ Strong database development and design experience with Oracle or other relational databases, including SQL query optimization, performance tuning, and schema design.
	+ Experience working with at least one NoSQL database such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar technologies.
	+ Good understanding of software design patterns, secure coding practices, and application performance optimization.
	+ Awareness of Python and its usage in automation, scripting, data processing, or AI/ML\-related initiatives.
	+ Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross\-functional distributed teams.
	+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
	+ Knowledge of Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Authentication, Authorization, Privileged Access Management, or related security domains is a strong plus.

 **Job Expectations:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React.
* Build and enhance cloud\-native solutions leveraging modern architecture principles and best engineering practices.
* Develop high\-quality, secure, and maintainable code with appropriate unit testing and automated test coverage.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and event\-driven integrations.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, security teams, and stakeholders to deliver business capabilities.
* Contribute to application modernization, cloud migration, and platform engineering initiatives.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Git, Harness, GitHub Actions, and related DevOps tools.
* Design and optimize database solutions, including relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Ensure application reliability, scalability, observability, and performance through engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical mentoring activities.
* Work closely with QA teams to improve automated test coverage and overall product quality.
* Adopt security\-by\-design principles and ensure compliance with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
* Continuously learn and apply emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices to improve delivery outcomes.
